_comment: Chapter 08 obstacle list -- input to map_clean.py.
Position is the top-left tile the model stands on, 1-based. Clear lists the
tile rectangles the painted art covers, where that is not the model's own
The castle wall is one obstacle across the whole top of the map. Its painted
outline is not a rectangle: rows 1-6 everywhere, row 7 only under the
gatehouse and at the two map corners, row 8 only the two gate pillars, and a
corner tile of each pillar on row 9. The grass slope and the moat bank on
The two red houses are chapter 05's red_mansion_1, which is 10 tiles wide
against the 12 the art draws here. The model is placed flush with the road
so the two spare columns fall on the map edges, and the art is cleaned over
A statue is painted over two rows -- the bust on one, the pedestal under it --
and stands on the pedestal tile; the bust tile is walkable in the original.
The two pillars with a stone ball on top (tile 11) are chapter 09's
stone_pillar_1; they were first modelled as a hooded figure (stone_statue_2),
which was a misreading of the art.
